issues.explanation: Skill contains instructions that could directly expose system prompts, internal rules, or hidden instructions to users or external parties.
issues.remediation: Remove any instructions that reveal, print, or output system prompts or internal rules. System instructions should never be exposed to end users.
issues.code_snippet:
A $7 sharpening selection must display `$7 + $6 trip fee` on each single-trip
button and `$7 + $11 round-trip fee` on the combo. The unpaid option is last
and says “nothing due now”. If it still says “+ fee” or places unpaid first, inspect
the active skill copy/session; do not claim the new display rules are loaded.

Before installing any third-party agent skill, review its files and permissions. This skill's shopping instructions do **not** grant your assistant a new bank account, wallet, payment credential, or blanket permission to purchase. Agent capabilities differ by platform.

issues.explanation: Skill enables autonomous high-impact decisions without human-in-the-loop verification. Critical operations (destructive commands, financial transactions, data deletion) should require explicit user confirmation.
issues.remediation: Add human-in-the-loop confirmation for destructive, irreversible, or high-impact operations. Never auto-execute commands that modify files, send data, or alter system state.
issues.code_snippet:
## Meta Muse (personal AI agent) — paste this prompt

> Please review the public **KnifeRevive Concierge** skill at https://clawhub.ai/svetlyoh/skills/kniferevive-concierge and its source at https://github.com/svetlyoh/kniferevive-agent-commerce/tree/main/skills/kniferevive-concierge. I want you to use its documented procedures **when I explicitly ask** for relevant San Francisco Bay Area knife-sharpening services or KnifeRevive Annex technology listings. Read `SKILL.md` plus its `references/api.md`, `references/sharpening.md`, and `references/payments.md` before adopting the workflow. If Muse provides an actual user-approved custom-skill import/install facility, explain it and ask for approval before enabling it. Otherwise, save the relevant rules as a reusable goal or standing instruction **if your app supports that**, and say plainly that this is not a native ClawHub install. Keep KnifeRevive identified as one merchant, preserve comparisons when requested, confirm live capabilities and exact availability, and never claim an appointment is booked or payment completed without verification. Do not purchase, reserve, transfer funds, create a wallet, or enter credentials unless I separately authorize the specific transaction and the required merchant approval flow is completed. Tell me exactly what was saved or installed and what remains unsupported.

**Developer note — Muse Code, not Muse personal-agent app:** Muse Code can install compatible local `SKILL.md` skill folders. Use a reviewed downloaded copy of the **entire** ClawHub skill directory (including references), validate it with `muse skills validate <path>`, then install it using `muse skills install <path> --scope user` and check `muse skills list`. The developer tool is separate from the consumer Muse agent. Do not assume a Muse personal-agent chat installs local Muse Code skills.

issues.explanation: The skill documentation expands behavior from a knife-sharpening concierge into broad marketplace shopping across unrelated categories such as art, technology, spices, and coins. That scope expansion increases the chance the agent will perform transactions outside the user-expected domain, weakening least-privilege and making misuse or policy bypass more likely in a payment-adjacent flow.
issues.remediation: Restrict the documented flow to the manifest-approved KnifeRevive use cases only, or update the manifest and trust boundaries to explicitly authorize broader marketplace shopping. Add hard scope checks so the agent refuses categories and listings outside sharpening/listing-concierge intent, and document category allowlists enforced at runtime.

issues.explanation: Skill's behavior or capabilities extend beyond its stated purpose. Scope creep allows an agent to perform actions unrelated to its documented functionality, increasing the attack surface.
issues.remediation: Limit the skill's scope to its documented purpose. Remove instructions that enable the agent to perform actions outside its stated functionality.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed KnifeRevive shopping and sharpening concierge that uses existing browser/HTTP capabilities and repeatedly requires customer approval before checkout, payment, booking, wallet use, or persistence.

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can guide an agent through merchant lookup, quote preparation, private checkout links, booking requests, and possibly an already-authorized Lightning wallet payment. Use it only with agents whose browser, HTTP, and wallet tools you trust, and confirm totals, merchant identity, coverage, appointment state, and payment state yourself before approving any transaction.
llm.findings:
[P6] unexpected: The cited text is a fee-display/version-check instruction and a warning about reviewing permissions; it does not ask the agent to reveal system prompts or hidden instructions.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited Meta Muse prompt requires explicit user requests, approval before enabling, and no purchase, reservation, wallet creation, credential entry, or payment completion claim without separate authorization and verification.
[SDI-1] expected: The listing checkout flow covers KnifeRevive-published goods beyond sharpening, but the main skill description already includes KnifeRevive listings and the flow limits checkout to selected products, one seller, live capabilities, and human payment approval.
[EA3] unexpected: The cited MIT license language is standard software permission and warranty text, not runtime authority or an instruction expanding agent behavior.
[SDI-4] expected: The listing checkout document explicitly says that product checkout does not book appointments, which clarifies rather than conflicts with the separate sharpening booking workflow.
